prompt: Only after the meter was disconnected _____ that the display had been recording the wrong channel.
promptZh: 直到儀表斷開後，技術員才發現顯示器一直在記錄錯誤的通道。

options.zh: 技術員發現了（一般語序）
options.whyZh: 句首 Only after 時間從句要求主句倒裝。

options.zh: 技術員已發現（過去完成式）
options.whyZh: 不但沒有倒裝，過去完成式也不符合「斷開後才發現」。
did 移至主詞前，realize 回到原形。
一般語序及現在式均不符。

explanationZh: did 移至主詞前，realize 回到原形。
evidence: Only after the meter was disconnected did the technician realize that the display had been recording the wrong channel.

vocabulary.note: 可指拔除設備的電源或訊號連接。
